cues.text: Three shots (IMPROVE 00a). Cover, frame one, host and dialog box hidden: our own split street at night, two shopfronts side by side (SHOP 1 left in teal, SHOP 2 right in red), a phone glowing in each window; the hook on a plate up top, "7 PM. Same call." / "Two shops.", tag EXAMPLE and "Rule: Google Local Services Help". By 0.8 s cut in to the two phones close up, split down the middle, both ringing, a ring bar under each; Snow and the dialog box come in. On "Nobody" cut to the third shot: both phones still ringing, the windows dark, "Nobody picks up." on the plate.
The ring bars keep filling; Snow shrugs.
The split screen, shop one's half lit and shop two's dimmed. Shop one's sign: ADS ON TILL 9 PM. The phone rings in the window.
The ring bar runs past the 20 s notch; the phone's screen turns to VOICEMAIL.
CHARGED LEAD stamps on shop one's half.
A coin drops out of the window; line "You paid for a ringing phone."
The split flips: shop two's half lit, shop one's dimmed. The setting card on shop two's half: AD SCHEDULE = HOURS A PERSON ANSWERS.
Shop two's sign: ADS OFF AT 5 PM. The 7 PM call rings; the window is dark.
A daytime strip: the desk phone rings out and an arrow carries it to a second phone, which lights up. Line: "Missed rings go to a second phone."
The chat set: the phone in the truck. A MISSED CALL banner drops in; the text back types out: "Sorry I missed you. What's the job, and when works?" EXAMPLE tag.
Under the phone: "Follow-ups in 15 days: not charged again."
The split-flap board, CHARGE STATUS: CHARGED, NOT CHARGED, IN REVIEW, CREDITED flip in row by row; strip under it: "Fridays: Leads page, Charge Status".
The gauge as a ring timer: dial THE LINE, the needle climbs to 20 s on "twenty". Source tag "Source: Google, How leads work" up top while it is said.
The versus screen, the scoreboard: SHOP 1 (CHARGED 1) against SHOP 2 (CHARGED 0); VS slams; WIN on shop two. Line: "Even voicemail counts."

Back on the split street at night, both windows dark. The DO THIS WEEK card: 1 Ad schedule: only hours a person answers. 2 Missed rings: a second phone. 3 Text back every missed call. 4 Fridays: Charge Status. Then the rule on "Run": "Run ads only when someone picks up."
The rule lands in gold; Snow waves. Then the end card with the send line: "Send this to whoever pays for your Google ads."
